lines.zh: 腐烂的肌肉颤动着前行
lines.en: Rotting flesh trembling forward
Sagging flesh shuffling

lines.zh: 干瘪的皮肤下露出骨骼
lines.en: Bones show through loose skin
Dragging a broken leg
Rotten flesh crunching
Staring, slowly approaching

lines.zh: 腐朽的肌肉发出嘶嘶声
lines.en: Rotting muscle hisses

lines.zh: 腐烂的血液顺着步伐滴落
lines.en: Rotten blood dripping with steps
Shuffling footsteps approaching

lines.zh: 阴冷的呼吸声在耳边响起
lines.en: Cold breath in your ear
Feet flying, I sprint across the gravel.
Leaning forward, I run full tilt.
Leaning on a rotten pillar
Rolling in rotten soil
Licking rotting hands
Chewing on rotten flesh
Dry eyeballs rolling
Staring at the player in the distance
Chomping on the stench of rot

lines.zh: 缓慢地咀嚼腐烂的骨头
lines.en: Slowly chewing on rotten bones
Leaning on a rotten barrel
Chomping on nearby rot
Suddenly staring at you

lines.zh: 眼白糊成一片，也认得路。
lines.en: My eyes are milky, but I know the way.
Slowly turning to find you

lines.zh: 张开嘴露出腐烂的牙齿
lines.en: Opening mouth to show rotting teeth
Staring at you with vacant eyes
Trying to find your silhouette
Fixing you with its gaze
Eyes following your movement

lines.zh: 我眼眶里没有眼白，只盯着你。
lines.en: No whites left in my eyes, only you.
Fixing you with fierce eyes
Leg broken, run!
Bitten, hurts!
This gash on my leg keeps tearing wider.
Too weak to move.
Infection, painful!
Starving, dizzy.

lines.zh: 浑身发冷，坚持不下去了。
lines.en: Freezing cold, can't move.
Heal me!
Can't be cured.
I fell, and my leg will not obey.

lines.zh: 饥渴难耐，奔尸向你逼近。
lines.en: Starving, the Runner moves in on you.
The smell of flesh is too tempting for the Runner.

lines.zh: 你身上的肉，奔尸垂涎欲滴。
lines.en: The Runner salivates at your flesh.

lines.zh: 饥不择食，奔尸已向你扑来。
lines.en: Starving, the Runner attacks you.

lines.zh: 饥饿驱使，奔尸欲咬你一口。
lines.en: Hunger drives the Runner to bite you.

lines.zh: 你身上的血，奔尸无法忽视。
lines.en: The Runner can’t ignore the blood on you.

lines.zh: 饥寒交迫，奔尸求食心切。
lines.en: Starving and freezing, the Runner seeks food.

lines.zh: 奔尸的牙齿，渴望你的肉。
lines.en: The Runner’s teeth crave your flesh.
Starvation makes the Runner wild.
The Runner’s cries are for food.
You collide with the Runner.

lines.zh: 奔尸冲撞过来，力道惊人。
lines.en: The Runner crashes into you with force.

lines.zh: 奔尸撞上你的身体，你被撞退。
lines.en: The Runner crashes into your body, knocking you back.
The Runner rams into your obstacle.
The Runner is knocked back by your attack.
You collide with the Runner, both falling down.

lines.zh: 奔尸撞上岩石，发出轰响。
lines.en: The Runner crashes into the rock, making a loud noise.

lines.zh: 奔尸撞向你，你闪避不及。
lines.en: The Runner crashes towards you, but you dodge.
You strike the Runner with an object.

lines.zh: 奔尸撞上树干，跌倒在地。
lines.en: The Runner crashes into a tree, falling to the ground.
The Runner searches for a mate.

lines.zh: 奔尸在荒野中寻找配偶。
lines.en: The Runner searches the wilderness for a mate.

lines.zh: 奔尸在月光下寻找交配对象。
lines.en: The Runner looks for a mate in the moonlight.
The Runner chases the nearby runners.

lines.zh: 奔尸在黑暗中寻找伴侣。
lines.en: The Runner searches for a partner in the dark.

lines.zh: 奔尸在墓地中寻找配偶。
lines.en: The Runner looks for a mate in the cemetery.

lines.zh: 奔尸在废墟中寻找交配对象。
lines.en: The Runner searches for a mate in the ruins.

lines.zh: 奔尸被同类吸引，靠近交配。
lines.en: The Runner is drawn to another runner for mating.
The Runner searches for a mating partner.

lines.zh: 奔尸在月黑风高的夜晚寻找配偶。
lines.en: The Runner searches for a mate in the dark of night.

lines.zh: 干枯的手臂在空中挥舞，寻找下一个目标。
lines.en: Dry arms wave for the next target.

lines.zh: 腐烂的手指抓向你的大腿。
lines.en: Rotten fingers grab your thigh.

lines.zh: 尖利的牙齿在你耳边嘶嘶作响。
lines.en: Sharp teeth hiss near your ear.

lines.zh: 饥饿的双眼盯着你的喉咙。
lines.en: Starved eyes lock on your throat.

lines.zh: 摇摇欲坠的头颅朝你倾斜过来。
lines.en: Rotting head tilts toward you.

lines.zh: 腐朽的手肘试图撞倒你。
lines.en: Rotting elbow tries to knock you down.

lines.zh: 僵硬的双手紧紧攥住你。
lines.en: Stiff hands tightly grasp you.

lines.zh: 腐烂的手腕试图撕裂你的皮肤。
lines.en: Rotten wrists try to rip your skin.

lines.zh: 僵硬的肩膀试图将你推倒。
lines.en: Stiff shoulders try to push you down.

lines.zh: 腐烂的双手紧紧缠住你的身体。
lines.en: Rotten hands tightly wrap around you.

lines.zh: 我闻到了你的气息，你逃不掉的。
lines.en: I smell your scent, you can't escape.

lines.zh: 你就是我的下一个猎物。
lines.en: You're my next meal.
You can't shake my attention.

lines.zh: 你退到墙边，正好省我几步。
lines.en: You back against the wall and save me a few steps.

lines.zh: 我已经锁定了你的位置。
lines.en: I've locked on to you.
You can't escape my hunt.

lines.zh: 你跑不远的，我的腿还听使唤。
lines.en: You will not get far; my legs still obey.

lines.zh: 你逃不掉的，我会吃掉你。
lines.en: You can't escape, I'll eat you.
Sweat and iron in the wind — that's you.

lines.zh: 你砸我的那一下，我记着。
lines.en: I remember that blow you landed on me.
Footsteps over there. Chase!
One whiff of blood and I charge.
A living one. Don't bother running.
I am faster than the wind.
My eyes lock on, and my legs move.
I'm about to consume you.

lines.zh: 你腿上那道口子，够我吃两天。
lines.en: That gash on your leg will feed me two days.

lines.zh: 我膝盖反着弯，追得上你。
lines.en: My knees bend backward; I keep up.
I'll rip your skin.
You'll feel the pain.
You'll die soon.
I'll eat you up.
You'll be my prey.
I'll drain your life.

lines.zh: 我会把你啃到只剩骨头。
lines.en: I'll gnaw you down to bare bone.
I cut a shortcut and come from the side.
You cannot outrun these legs.
You are almost out of breath.
Knocking you down is faster than biting.
Once the wound opens, you bleed out.
I run right beside you, waiting for you to stop.

lines.zh: 巷口砌着砖墙，你只能回头。
lines.en: The alley ends in brick; you can only turn back.
One bite, and you turn.

lines.zh: 我的牙咬进你的肩膀了。
lines.en: My teeth are in your shoulder.
Leg broken! Pain!

lines.zh: 我咬住你的袖口，往墙里拖。
lines.en: I bite your sleeve and drag you toward the wall.
Be bitten now!
Don't move!
My teeth are bleeding!
Your blood is my food!
I'm here, taste my sharp teeth!

lines.zh: 你转身的工夫，我牙已经到了。
lines.en: While you turn, my teeth are already there.
Even limping, I am faster than you.
My whole body slams into you.
I bite your shoulder and keep running.
My nails rake your neck.
I tackle you down and pin you.
One kick knocks your shield aside.
I bite, fall back, and lunge again.
New prey appears!
This suits me well!
Find food!

lines.zh: 这条街上，还没有我的人。
lines.en: No one of mine holds this street yet.

lines.zh: 这条巷子没活人，我先蹲下。
lines.en: No living soul in this alley; I crouch down first.
I'm here, lead the way!
New enemies appear!
Explore the unknown!

lines.zh: 我从这片废墟里爬起来。
lines.en: I pick myself up out of these ruins.
Rapid footsteps come from afar.
It bursts out from the street corner.
Just turned, legs still shaking.
A running shadow clears the low wall.

lines.zh: 血腥味把它引到了这里。
lines.en: The smell of blood led it here.
On fire, run!
Fallen, broken leg!

lines.zh: 水里跑不快，可我还在扑腾。
lines.en: I cannot run in water, but I keep thrashing.
The blast tears half my shoulder away.
The arrow's in my shoulder — I can't run!
Cursed, injured!

lines.zh: 饿久了，连腿都不听使唤。
lines.en: Starved too long. My legs won't obey.
Lightning hit!
Void, dead.
